description: Land Acquisition - Pahala Andarawewa D/S Division, Hambantota District - Meegahajadura and Weliwewa, Sooriyawewa D/S Division, Hambantota - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 1463/19 of 20.09.2006
reasoning: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition by the government for public purposes (road development and airport access). It contains detailed descriptions of specific land lots being acquired, their locations, extents, and claimant information. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "land development projects." While it involves government action, the core subject matter is land acquisition rather than government structure or personnel changes.
